heading: Our workshop in Umm Al Quwain
intro: FANN is a UAE exhibition stand design-and-build company with its own workshop in Umm Al Quwain and an office in Dubai. The workshop covers about 5,000 sq m.
evidence: Our workshop photos show the space behind our work: workbenches, sheet materials, components being assembled and large-format printing equipment. These are images from our own workshop, not stock photographs or design renders.
